_comment: Copy-paste (clone) detection for the refactor. Advisory discovery tool, NOT a gate — the twin of stryker.config.json / mutants.toml in philosophy: it produces a signal, it does not block. dependency-cruiser maps *structure*; jscpd finds *duplication* to consolidate. Run: pnpm dup (console + reports/duplication/{html,json,md}). Scope: the four hand-written source trees; tests/fixtures/goldens/locales/generated are excluded because near-identical test setup and translated strings are expected duplication, not a refactor target. Tighten minTokens once the obvious clones are gone.
